stair_transition_coverage.scope: geometry and actual environment coverage only; not a behavior or success claim

actuator_guard.scope: all training environments since last log; 200 Hz, including resets

stair_speed.criterion: eligible forward exit > 4m without physical termination; not independent stair completion
stair_speed.statistics_mode: cumulative stochastic training episodes; no automatic speed-weight adjustment

phase_pose.diagnostic_scope: current control step across training environments, not held-out performance

sampling_contract.boundary_policy: magnitude-preserving reflections, up to four resamples, then 0.2 m/s cardinal recovery
sampling_contract.probabilities_scope: base sampler; sequence cohort and boundary handling alter final frequencies

boundary.prediction: 5s body twist integrated using measured yaw

omni_lift.scope: exact flat terrain membership; current training environments, not held-out performance
omni_lift.clearance_reference: wheel link z - flat env origin z - 0.093 m radius

early_restart.scope: flat and geometry-normal stairs/high-platform phases; released while climbing
early_restart.reward_diagnostics_source: actual active RewardTermCfg function and params

terrain_allocation.evidence: matched training strata, not independent held-out validation

pit.acceptance: all wheels supported on top, full collision body past edge, quiet/upright for 2s
pit.stop_protocol: external perfect-state stop command on platform; not autonomous student detection
pit.course_evidence: disjoint stochastic training batches; not independent held-out evaluation
